scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('node_modules')){console.log('[prestart] node_modules missing; running npm ci...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm ci --no-audit --no-fund',{stdio:'inherit'});} else {console.log('[prestart] node_modules present; skipping npm ci.');}"
scripts.pretest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('node_modules')){console.log('[pretest] node_modules missing; running npm ci...'); require('child_process').execSync('npm ci --no-audit --no-fund',{stdio:'inherit'});} else {console.log('[pretest] node_modules present; skipping npm ci.');}"
